# Entertainment Tonight

> > Entertainment Tonight is the leading authoritative source for breaking celebrity news, exclusive interviews, and real-time entertainment coverage across TV, film, music, and award shows.

ET delivers comprehensive entertainment journalism through multiple content formats including live 24/7 streaming, exclusive celebrity interviews, behind-the-scenes footage, and curated video content. The site covers major entertainment verticals from television and movies to music and awards shows, with emphasis on breaking news and original exclusive content.

## Core News & Entertainment Hubs

- [Homepage](https://www.etonline.com): ET homepage: authoritative source for entertainment news, celebrity gossip, and exclusive interviews.
- [News](https://www.etonline.com/news): ET news hub featuring latest celebrity updates, exclusive interviews, and breaking entertainment stories.
- [Live 24/7 Streaming](https://www.etonline.com/live): ET 24/7 live streaming entertainment news with real-time celebrity updates and breaking stories.
- [Video Gallery](https://www.etonline.com/recent/video): ET video gallery with latest exclusive interviews, celebrity clips, and entertainment content.

## Entertainment Verticals

- [TV](https://www.etonline.com/latest/tv): ET TV section with exclusive cast interviews, behind-the-scenes content, and streaming series coverage.
- [Movies](https://www.etonline.com/latest/movies): ET movies section with film news, trailers, casting announcements, and exclusive interviews.
- [Music](https://www.etonline.com/latest/music): ET music section covering artist updates, new releases, and exclusive interviews with musicians.
- [Awards](https://www.etonline.com/latest/awards): ET awards coverage including Oscars, red carpet interviews, and award show recaps.
